_meta.notes: SYNTHETIC, hand-built from Shuttle-class entry figures: a 90-tonne lifting body holding 40° alpha through the high-heating band around 60 km. Wing area 250 m², entry ballistic coefficient just under 400 kg/m², L/D about 1. Indicated airspeed is small despite Mach 20 because the air is thin, which is the pairing this widget exists to show.
_meta.sources: Orbiter reference wing area 249.9 m²; entry alpha 40°; hypersonic L/D near 1; specific excess power is -D·V/m with D 204 kN, V 6 km/s, m 90 t.
